_note: 3.0 configuration. Written by the build agent 2026-11-05. Change freely. Paths are path_for keys plus a relative part. Entries under assumed_inputs are not held. Scripts fail with a message naming them.

scoring_defaults._cutoff_note: Primary proposal cutoff, matching and K come from ek.policy_for(task) (policy fw00_s4_20261105). Pit 0.35 and pad 0.525 are the sweep's leave-one-fold-out cutoffs. cutoff_by_task mirrors them for reading only and a test checks it equals policy_for. 0.10 is the fw_00 sensitivity (mode sensitivity). At 0.10 the 9t uint8 mosaic gives recall 0.575 at K 40.
scoring_defaults._void_cap_note: Review G-05. Interior nodata counts toward a block's void fraction. A block is dropped when the void fraction exceeds the preregistered cap, else this default. User accepted the default 0.5 on 2026-11-06 (take defaults, decisions_3_0.md).
scoring_defaults._zero_feature_fill_note: Review G-02. 9t blocks with no feature were never in any training manifest, so every fold model is out of sample there. round_robin gives block b the fold model (sorted position of b among the fill blocks) mod 5, one model per block like a held-out block. fold_mean is the sensitivity. User accepted round_robin as primary on 2026-11-06 (take defaults). It gives the same pit recall 0.946 as fold_mean.
scoring_defaults._margin_note: User default 2026-11-06. Non-inferiority margin and useful gain are 0.03 recall unless a preregistration states its own with a burden source.

multiplicity.default_family: the one primary of the preregistration
multiplicity._note: User default 2026-11-06. Holm over the declared primary gates of an expansion only. Secondaries and sensitivities are reported, never gated. Code in _transfer_holm_gate.py.

pad._note: layer 'pad' resolves to 'plat' through read_layer legacy aliases, as in _pad_unet_cv5.py.
provisional_reasons: fold split from the P1 dry run, not the frozen file
